summary: <Link> wraps <Button>, producing <a><button> (invalid nested interactive content, two tab stops, conflicting roles). Same pattern at profile-header.tsx:143 (Group settings), profile-projects.tsx:110 (New project), profile-groups.tsx:96 (New group), profile-certs.tsx:165 (New activity).
fix: Give Button a link mode (e.g. export a buttonClassName(variant,size) helper or an `href`/asChild prop) and render a single <Link className={buttonClassName(...)}>; move aria-label/tooltip onto the Link.

summary: .profile-overview__type-chip:focus-visible removes the outline and replaces it with a 2px ring of --overlay-weak (4% alpha), so keyboard focus on the organization-type chips is effectively invisible in both themes.
fix: Drop the override and let the global button:focus-visible rule apply (outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px), or set that outline explicitly.

summary: .project-detail__cert-menu-btn:focus-visible sets outline:none and only paints a 4% --overlay-weak tint, so the per-activity menu trigger has no visible focus indicator.
fix: Split :focus-visible out of the shared hover/expanded rule and keep outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px.

summary: Profile sections render role="tabpanel" with aria-labelledby="tab-overview"/"tab-about"/... but no element has those ids. The mobile strip (line 469) uses <button aria-current> inside a <nav>, not role=tab, so the panels are orphaned and have no accessible name.
fix: Either adopt <Tabs>/<TabList>/<Tab>/<TabPanel> from src/components/ui/tabs.tsx, or drop role=tabpanel and aria-labelledby and use a plain <section aria-label={tabLabel}>, which matches the nav + aria-current pattern.

summary:
The create-activity page has no

: the title is an , and the first heading is

Description

. The same is true of src/app/project/new/page.tsx:341, src/app/groups/create/page.tsx:495 and src/components/project/project-edit-route.tsx:614.
fix: Add a visually hidden <h1 className="sr-only"> ("New activity", "New project", "New group", "Edit project") at the top of each form.

summary: Create and edit flows lose drafts silently: Cancel calls router.back() or push() and there is no beforeunload guard. The same applies to project/new, groups/create, project-edit-route, profile-edit-form.tsx:325 (handleCancel and the Back link) and groups/[groupDid]/edit-profile. Inline profile edit already guards via src/hooks/use-profile-inline-edit.ts, so the behavior is inconsistent.
fix: Extract the beforeunload logic from use-profile-inline-edit into a shared useUnsavedChangesGuard(isDirty) hook. Use it in these flows, and confirm with <ConfirmDialog> on Cancel/Back when the form is dirty.

summary: Publish is disabled={!canSubmit} until every rule passes (title/short-description minimums, contributor validity, dates), and nothing says which rule is failing. The same pitfall appears in funding-receipt-form-modal.tsx:379 (Record) and profile-edit-form.tsx:596 (Save changes).
fix: Keep submit enabled (disable only while submitting). On submit, run validation, focus the first invalid field and show its inline error, or at minimum list the unmet requirements next to the button.

summary: The amount field validates with Number(raw) > 0 (line 43) but shows no inline error. Values like "1,000", "10 USDC" or "abc" just leave Record disabled with no explanation, and there is no aria-invalid.
fix: Show an inline error (role=alert, aria-describedby, aria-invalid) after blur or submit when the amount does not parse. Consider stripping thousands separators before parsing.

summary: The "Link" and "Embed" <label>s have no htmlFor and do not wrap their inputs, so the read-only URL input and embed textarea are unlabeled. The copy confirmation is an icon swap only, with no announcement. The fields also hand-roll <Input>/<Textarea> chrome.
fix: Use useId and htmlFor, or the label prop of <Input>/<Textarea> (readOnly). Add an sr-only aria-live="polite" region announcing "Copied".

summary:
The bulk-paste textarea has no label and relies on a placeholder plus a separate help

. The duplicate at endorsement-lists.tsx:1178 has the same problem.
fix: Add aria-label="Handles, DIDs or URLs to add" (or a visible <label>) and aria-describedby pointing at the help paragraph id.

summary: The add-to-list search input sits inside a <label> whose only content is an aria-hidden icon, so its accessible name comes only from the placeholder.
fix: Add aria-label (e.g. `Search ${LABELS[type]}`) and type="search", matching endorse-people-modal.tsx:291.

summary: The avatar upload trigger is a <div role=button tabIndex=0>, and its camera overlay appears only on mouseenter. Keyboard and touch users never see the upload affordance. Used by profile-edit-form and groups/[groupDid]/edit-profile.
fix: Render a real <button type="button" aria-label="Upload avatar">. Show the overlay on :hover, :focus-visible and touch via CSS (or always show a small camera badge, as profile-sidebar__avatar-edit-btn does).

summary: Several inputs render below 16px on mobile, which triggers iOS focus-zoom: .funding-form__input (0.875rem), .profile-endorsements-v2__search-input and .profile-groups__search-input (0.875rem), .profile-lists__paste-textarea (0.8125rem), .profile-overview__location-input (0.875rem), .endorse-reason-modal__textarea (0.9375rem). The codebase already uses the fix elsewhere (components.css:1304, cert-detail meta inputs).
fix: Add @media (max-width: 799px) { <selector> { font-size: 16px; } } for each of these inputs, following the existing pattern.

summary: On mobile, the endorsements and groups search pills shrink to 28px and 30px tall (profile-endorsements.css:82, profile-groups.css:115), below the 44px tap target the rest of the app enforces under 799px.
fix: Set min-height: 44px on the mobile search pill (or 40px if paired with the 16px font fix) so it matches the sort buttons and the layout.css 44px convention.

summary: .profile-hero__name (the mobile profile H1) and .profile-hero__handle have no overflow-wrap. A long unbroken display name, or a fallback handle like averyveryverylongname.bsky.social, overflows the viewport on phones.
fix: Add overflow-wrap: anywhere; min-width: 0 to .profile-hero__name and .profile-hero__handle, as project-detail__title does on mobile.

summary: Handle and Email hints (create-group__field-hint) and their errors are not linked to the inputs: no aria-describedby and no aria-invalid. The handle input also lacks autoCapitalize="none" and spellCheck={false}, so mobile keyboards capitalise and autocorrect it. These fields hand-roll raw <input>s, whereas the activity create page uses <Input flush>.
fix: Give the hint and error ids, set aria-describedby and aria-invalid={!!handleError}, and add autoCapitalize="none" spellCheck={false} to handle and email. Optionally migrate to <Input flush density="compact">.

summary: The org location field hand-rolls a combobox (role, aria-activedescendant, Arrow/Escape handling, blur timer), as does location-picker-dialog.tsx:377. src/components/ui/combobox.tsx already provides this state machine plus a live result-count region, and four other surfaces use it. Neither hand-rolled copy announces result counts.
fix: Migrate both location typeaheads to <Combobox> (use renderInput to keep the compact chrome) and delete the duplicated keyboard and blur logic.

summary: The sticky footer Cancel and Save use bespoke .pe__action-btn buttons, and Add URL is .pe__url-add, instead of <Button variant="ghost"|"primary">. Save has no loading spinner. The form is also not a <form>, so Enter does not submit (groups/[groupDid]/edit-profile/page.tsx:196 has the same issue).
fix: Replace with <Button variant="ghost"> and <Button variant="primary" loading={isSaving} type="submit">, and wrap the fields in a <form onSubmit>.

summary: The project head actions (.project-detail__edit-btn and .project-detail__delete-btn, raw <button> plus Tooltip), .project-detail__add-cert-btn (1303), .project-detail__add-cert-cancel (1324) and .project-detail__desc-preserve-cta (1254) are bespoke button vocabularies instead of <Button> (variant secondary/ghost, size sm, size icon with aria-label).
fix: Migrate to <Button>. The delete trigger becomes <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" aria-label="Delete project">. Review the visual delta first.

summary: The empty-state copy "When you join a group, it'll appear here." is shown when visiting someone else's profile too. isOwnProfile is available, and profile-projects.tsx:203 already branches on the owner.
fix: Branch on isOwnProfile: owner sees "When you join a group, it’ll appear here.", visitors see "Groups this profile belongs to will appear here."

summary: Error titles mix straight and curly apostrophes: "Couldn't load groups" here and in profile-projects.tsx:188, while followers and endorsements use "Couldn’t". handle-search.tsx:40 uses "Search by handle..." with three dots instead of an ellipsis character.
fix: Use ’ (or ’) and … consistently.

summary: Load-error EmptyStates (projects, groups at profile-groups.tsx:177, followers at profile-followers.tsx:326/416) show the raw error message and offer no recovery action.
fix: Pass an action={<Button size="sm" variant="secondary" onClick={retry}>Try again</Button>} and use a friendly description, logging the raw error.

summary:
Board save errors render as a plain

with no role=alert, so screen readers are not told the save failed. Same at board-settings-dialog.tsx:234.
fix: Add role="alert" or use <ErrorMessage>.

summary: The tile hover reveal (.contributor-tile__hover) is shown only on :hover, so keyboard users who focus a link or video tile (focus-visible ring at line 95) never see it.
fix: Extend the selector: .contributor-tile:hover .contributor-tile__hover, .contributor-tile:focus-visible .contributor-tile__hover { ... }.

summary: Every activity row's menu trigger has the same aria-label, "Activity actions", so a screen-reader button list can't distinguish them. Likewise profile-edit-form.tsx:516/531/540 repeats "URL", "Link label" and "Remove URL" on every row.
fix: Include context, e.g. `Actions for ${title}`, `URL ${i+1}`, `Remove ${row.label || row.url || `URL ${i+1}`}`.

summary: Character counters use aria-live="polite" and update on every keystroke ("12/120 · min. 10 characters"), which floods screen readers while typing. Also at create/page.tsx:889, endorse-reason-modal.tsx:155 and endorse-people-modal.tsx:270.
fix: Remove aria-live from the counter and link it via aria-describedby, or announce only at thresholds (over the limit, 25 left) through a separate sr-only region.

summary: The outer <div role=group> and the inner ToggleGroup carry the same aria-label ("Response to endorsement from X"), so the group name is announced twice. The error text uses an off-scale text-[0.6875rem] (line 165).
fix: Drop role and aria-label from the wrapper (keep aria-busy) and use text-caption for the error.

summary: The org-type chip list is <ul role="group"> with no accessible name. The role overrides the list semantics, and the group is unnamed even though the heading has id profile-overview-type-heading.
fix: Use <div role="group" aria-labelledby="profile-overview-type-heading"> (or keep the <ul> without a role).

summary: .profile-sidebar__name (layout.css:2003) is white-space:nowrap with an ellipsis but has no title or alternative, so long display names are cut off with no way to read them. In edit mode the <h1> wraps an <Input> (line 237), which leaves the heading with no text for assistive tech.
fix: Add title={displayName} to the read-mode h1 (or allow a 2-line clamp). In edit mode, render the Input outside the h1 or keep an sr-only heading.

summary: Inline style objects are used for spacing and color: style={{ marginTop: 4 }} (groups/create 575, 608), style={{ marginTop: 6 }} (profile-overview.tsx:171), style={{ flexShrink: 0, color: "var(--fg-muted)" }} (project/new/page.tsx:419, project-edit-route.tsx:692).
fix: Move them into the BEM class or Tailwind utilities (mt-1, shrink-0, text-[var(--fg-muted)]).

summary: COLOR_SEED = "#888888" is a raw hex in TSX (hard rule 2). input[type=color] requires a hex value, but the literal is undocumented.
fix: Add a comment explaining that input[type=color] needs a #rrggbb seed, or read a token at runtime via getComputedStyle(...).getPropertyValue('--fg-muted') and normalise it.

summary: The page H1 is just "Edit", and the save button reads "Save Changes" (Title Case), while profile-edit-form uses "Save changes" (sentence case).
fix: Use "Edit group profile" and "Save changes".

summary: Audit log rows show the actor as a raw DID and the timestamp via bare toLocaleString() (seconds included, no relative time), which is hard to scan next to the rest of the app's hydrated identities and formatted dates.
fix: Render the actor with HydratedIdentityRow or an @handle (DID in title), and format the date with the shared date helper (formatShortDate or relative time, with the full timestamp in <time title>).

summary: The funding form hand-rolls role radio pills (.funding-form__direction) and raw inputs and textareas (.funding-form__input) instead of <SegmentedControl>/<Radio> and <Input>/<Textarea>, so it duplicates focus, error and size chrome.
fix: Migrate to the ui primitives (SegmentedControl for role, Input with label for amount, date and details, Textarea for notes) and delete the duplicated funding-form.css input rules.

summary: The "Additional URLs" heading is a <label> with no associated control (no htmlFor, no wrapped input).
fix: Use a <fieldset> with <legend>Additional URLs</legend> around the URL rows, or a <span>/<h3>.
